scalars.scalar_value: Healthcare or academic medical center experience preferred

items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and experience
Healthcare or academic medical center experience preferred
Lead the technology foundation behind UCLA Health’s mission and help shape its next generation of secure, resilient, and intelligent infrastructure.
UCLA Health is seeking a visionary technology leader to guide the infrastructure and operations that power one of the nation’s leading academic health systems.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead enterprise infrastructure, cloud, network, architecture, platform, development, and operational services supporting a secure and highly available 24/7 environment.
Set the strategic direction for enterprise infrastructure and operations
Lead and develop a large organization of technology leaders and professionals
Modernize cloud, on-premises, network, compute, storage, and monitoring capabilities
Build artificial intelligence-ready infrastructure and advance intelligent automation
Strengthen cybersecurity, resilience, disaster recovery, and business continuity
Oversee technology roadmaps, budgets, investments, and strategic vendors
Deliver reliable technology that supports patient care, education, research, and community engagement
10 or more years of enterprise infrastructure and operations leadership
Understanding of advanced networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, network security)
Success managing complex, mission-critical technology environments
Understanding of EMR/EHR technical architecture and deployment
Expertise across cloud, networking, data centers, enterprise architecture, and infrastructure platforms
Understanding of information technology across the domains of Academic Medical Centers comprised of a multitude of clinicians, researchers, educators and a multitude of administrators
Strong strategic, financial, operational, and people leadership skills

Ability to communicate with people effectively, organize resources within teams and motivate others, including effective facilitation, consensus building, and multi-level communications on issues and incidents across stakeholder groups and support teams to ensure clarity, prioritization, and resolutions
Ability to analyze complex end-user business needs and devise effective cost-efficient solutions
Ability to skillfully react and adapt to a fluid and constantly changing and evolving work environment

Demonstrated ability to accomplish and direct financial evaluations of new and existing projects, products, services, and operations maintenance, driving opportunities for scaling or reducing costs and investments, including through consolidation and rationalization
Demonstrated ability to analyze information and situations to identify relevant issues, propose solutions, recognize alternatives, and to present this in a logical and objective manner
Demonstrated ability to participate in the development, justification and management of a multi-million dollar operating and capital budget
Demonstrated ability to work well both independently and in team-oriented environment
Demonstrated ability to work well with external organizations and vendors in obtaining and coordinating services
Demonstrated negotiating, communications, and diplomacy skills
Interpersonal and leaderships skills to build relationships and work effectively with staff, faculty, administrators and external colleagues and partners
